fields: *Rascal and Melody make their way to an open meadow. They join a group of critters at a bed of flowers*
Melodyyyy who is this cute lil stud? Is he gonna be our toy for the day?
Ladies, ladies! Don’t sound so desperate, heavens!
Hey that’s all Becka! She’s the thirsty one!
That’s right! Thirsty and proud! Bok bok!
The name’s Rascal! I’m here to quench your thirst!
D’ohoho! Quite the silver tongue on this fella! Where didja find this critter Melody?
He’s new on the other side of the forest. He’s been helping Charlotte and I out.
So I figured I could treat him to a fun day with the gals!
Heh, two birds with one stone! Er, no offense…
None taken so long as I get first dibs! Let me at him!
Tag me in when you’re finished!
*Rascal and Becka make their way to a nearby clearing…*
So, you ever get it on with a bird before?
I have not! But I’m familiar with what goes on down there.
Great, I don’t have to teach you then!
Don’t be shy now, grab me by the hips and go to town!
You don’t need a warm up?
Oh damn Rascal, you’re packin’! Bok!
I-… Did I just go in a different hole?
Mmm~ Yeah, ah~ Don’t worry about it…
In fact… feel free to- nnnf switch it up…
Mmm, hey Rascal. Do me a favor?
Pull out and make me a mess.
I wanna show the gals. Plus, Melody will clean me right up…
I’m about to lose it anyway!
Gosh, what a pent up guy!
Heh… I can be quite… productive.
I’ll say! This is perfect. I’ll send Merrygold over next!
*Some time passes and Marygold pops her head out of a nearby bush*
Hey Rascal… You really gave it to Becka huh?
She was a mess! I bet that was her idea.
Yeah! She said she wanted Melody to clean her up.
Well Rascal… I’ve got a bit of a request myself…
First, let’s see what we’re workin’ with…
Mmm… I can still taste Becka on you…
Hmm, both holes? I bet that was her idea too…
Here’s my little kink… I like it when my partner is in their throes of passion, and they get rough.
Don’t worry, I’m a big gal, I can take it!
Just get lost in the moment, don’t worry about me~
Well, I am getting pretty close…
*She nods as her tail wags wildly*
Alright… Well I’m not gonna last long with you doing whatever you’re doing there…
Ahhh hah… Just a lil… more…
Let me, hah… catch my breath…
Sorry, was I holding you down?
Just a bit. But I could easily have yanked away if I wanted.
But that’s what I love to see… What my partner does when they are in the moment…
You seem to lose control of those claws
Yeah… I was… trying to be rough? I don’t know this is my first time.
Haha, yeah that’s ok! It was cute, and does more for me than you know…
So can I like… I dunno spank you and help you finish? or…?
It’s actually hard for me to finish with new partners. Just another quirk of mine.
I was just here to have some fun with you~!
Oh! Okay well rain check then!
Sounds good. Let’s head back, I could use a snack!
I wasn’t filling enough for you?
Rascal, that was fun, but you’re like, thirty pounds.
*Rascal and Marygold make their way back to Melody and Rebecka*
Great timing, I just got Rebecka all cleaned up.
Yes darling, someone certainly was squeaking, that’s for sure…
Definitely a keeper! We’re going to have to fool around again real soon!
But uh… I could do with a bite to eat…
*The critters spend the rest of the evening with food and drink, before making their way back home.*
